findings: Seven event/repository files whole-read/Gitblobverified. All common repository interfaces now inspected, plus report repository earlier. They declare JPA persistence only, no hash metric search/index or fingerprint recipe compatibility check.

LocalNodeRepository.get and NetworkConfigurationRepository.get query ID0 explicitly; rows with other IDs ignored by singleton access. Database uniqueness of single logical config beyond primaryID convention not demonstrated.

LocalNodeUpdatedEvent stores same mutable Node reference, NetworkConfigurationUpdatedEvent stores same config reference; no defensive snapshot and no subscription initialization in event constructors. Listener implementations still need inspection.
ImageRepository is JpaRepository<Image,String>; no composite collection/archive identity introduced here, consistent with previously reviewed basenameID concern.
NodeRepository filters NodeType, not online/active state; caller filtering remains separate. No database or event dispatch runtime qualification.
remaining: Event listeners in startup/web services, remaining authored resources/native binaries and runtime qualification
